metaTitle: Custom Full Color Headphones | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color headphones with your logo. Perfect for trade shows, events, and corporate gifts. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Full color decoration on headphones lets you reproduce complex logos, gradients, or photographic images with vibrant accuracy. Unlike one- or two-color imprints, full color prints give you unlimited design freedom on earbuds, over-ears, and headset cases. Whether you need branded earbuds for a product launch or custom headphones for a company milestone, full color ensures your artwork stands out with maximum detail and impact.
heroAltText: Custom full color headphones with vibrant printed logo on ear cups and case
